variations.title: The sneakers
variations.premise: Malik sells his Jordans to fund fomo instead of emptying his college fund, and pays Tasha back with designer slippers instead of a groceries comeback.
variations.script:
SCENE 1 — INT. HALLWAY — DAY
Aunt Tasha holds up an empty sneaker box, the lid hanging off.
TASHA: You SOLD your Jordans?! Those were four hundred dollars!
MALIK: Sold them. Every cent went into fomo.
TASHA: Shoes you can wear. You can't wear an app!
MALIK: Four weeks. Then we talk.
TASHA: Four weeks. Then you're wearing my old slippers to school.
SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
Malik sits on the floor in his socks, the empty sneaker box beside him, lit blue by the phone.
MALIK: Okay. Once more.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — fills the frame, a phone ding
Wordless montage, Malik in every shot, getting rich: a courier stacks a tower of sneaker boxes into Malik's arms, Malik laces brand-new high-tops on a showroom bench, Malik behind the wheel of a black SUV, Malik walks into a glass sneaker vault lined with his own shelves.
SCENE 3 — INT. HALLWAY — DAY, FOUR WEEKS LATER
Malik hands Tasha a gift box. His phone lies on the lid.
★ fomo screen: Home — the portfolio balance reads $412,606.80
TASHA: Is that… your balance?
Tasha lifts the lid: a pair of plush designer slippers.
MALIK: And those are your new slippers.
MALIK: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
changes: The stakes are his sold sneakers, not the college fund.
The dare is four weeks, and the threat is wearing Tasha's old slippers.
The montage climbs through sneakers: a tower of boxes, new high-tops, an SUV, his own sneaker vault.
The payoff is a gift box: his balance on the lid, designer slippers inside.
